resources.string: The tile cannot unlock. Hold two opposite corners for two seconds, or restart the phone.
Shown while the screen is locked for a child.

Hold two opposite corners for two seconds to unlock. Restarting the phone also unlocks it. There is no button here on purpose: anything tappable in this shade is within reach of whoever is holding the phone.
Pin the app now if you want the notification shade blocked too: open Recents, then tap the pin icon on the app. Tap the Kid lock tile again to cancel.
Tiny Finger Stopper needs the "display over other apps" permission before it can lock the screen.
Could not put the lock on screen. Check the "display over other apps" permission.
This video\'s owner does not allow it to play outside YouTube. Use the overlay lock for this one.
YouTube refused to play this in Kid Player (error %1$d).
That video is private, removed, or not available here.
YouTube could not play this video (error %1$d).
Paste a YouTube link or an 11-character video id.
Could not bring the locked app back to the front. The screen is still locked, and it will keep trying.
Works over any app. Start a video in YouTube, Disney+ or anything else, pull down Quick Settings and tap the Kid lock tile. Touches stop reaching the app underneath.
Required. This is the permission that puts the touch blocker on screen.
Required. The ongoing notification is how the lock stays running, and it carries an Unlock button.
Optional. Android will not let any app block the Home gesture, so with this granted the lock instead notices the escape and brings the video straight back.
Optional. Adds the Kid lock tile so you can arm it in one tap.
To add the tile: pull down Quick Settings, tap the edit (pencil) button, and drag "Kid lock" into the panel.

Recommended. Swiping Home during a video makes YouTube shrink into a floating window, and a floating window cannot be pulled back to full screen by another app, so snap-back cannot undo it. On YouTube\'s app info page, find Picture-in-picture and turn it off.

Stronger, YouTube only. The video plays inside this app, which lets it use Android\'s own screen pinning to block Home, Recents and the notification shade outright. You can also share a YouTube link into Tiny Finger Stopper from anywhere.
Strongly recommended. In Security (or Security and privacy) find App pinning, turn it on, and turn on "Ask for PIN before unpinning". With that set, leaving Kid Player needs your device PIN.

Android puts the notification shade above any app overlay, so an overlay alone cannot keep it shut. Screen pinning can, but only the app being pinned may ask for it. A delay gives you time to pin the app from Recents yourself before the lock goes up.

The tile can only arm the lock, never release it, so reaching the shade is no longer a way out. If you want the shade shut as well, either use Kid Player below, or set an arm delay and pin the app from Recents during the countdown.
To unlock either mode: put one finger in one corner and another finger in the diagonally opposite corner, and hold for two seconds.
Restarting the phone always cancels the lock. Nothing about the lock is saved to disk and nothing in this app runs at boot.
